steps.title: Welcome to Northbridge
steps.text: Welcome to Northbridge, where it's your first week and your inbox is already filling up. Somewhere in there is one message built to fool you, because most break-ins start with a single quiet click. Luckily you have Shield, a sidekick who taps your shoulder before that click. Today your team decides what's safe and what's a trap, so let's see who can outsmart the inbox!

steps.title: What is Inbox Showdown?
steps.text: Inbox Showdown is a party game for 2 to 6 teams sharing one screen. Each round, a team gets one message, like an email, a text, or a phone call, and decides if it's safe or a scam. Every team plays three messages, and the most points wins. A match takes about three minutes.

steps.title: Share one inbox
steps.text: Hey team! You'll take turns on one shared inbox, one message per turn.

steps.title: Open, Report, or Ask
steps.text: Read who sent it, then tap Open if it looks safe, Report if it's a scam, or Ask Shield for a hint.

steps.title: Challenge to steal
steps.text: Think another team got it wrong? Hit Challenge, and if you're right, you steal fifty points.

steps.title: Shield has your back
steps.text: Try to open something risky and Shield steps in first, so you can back out.

steps.title: Most points wins
steps.text: Each team gets three messages. Right calls earn a hundred points. Ready? Let's play!
